stories.title: Teams arrive in Calgary ahead of Grey Cup final
stories.summary: The Edmonton Elks and the Montreal Alouettes arrive in Calgary today ahead of Sunday's 113th Grey Cup showdown.

stories.title: Levi gives Oilers confidence in the crease
stories.summary: The Edmonton Oilers are hoping they finally have the so-called goalie of the future in Devon Levi.

stories.title: Draisaitl scores twice as Oilers beat Rangers 3-1
stories.summary: Leon Draisaitl scored a pair of goals as the Edmonton Oilers swept their season series with New York, holding on to defeat the Rangers 3-1 on Monday.

stories.title: What’s going on with the Russia IIHF World Juniors controversy?
stories.summary: The decision by the International Ice Hockey Federation to allow Russia back into the World Juniors Hockey Championship next month is continuing to stir backlash.

stories.title: 15 soldiers on ventilators, 9 critical after deadly CFB Wainwright fire
stories.summary: A senior Alberta government official provided Global News with a confidential briefing after nearly a week of unanswered questions to the Department of National Defence.

stories.title: Alberta advancing plans to open 9 new urgent care centres
stories.summary: The centres are planned for west and south Edmonton, the Stony Plain-Spruce Grove area, east Calgary, Lethbridge, Medicine Hat, Cold Lake, Fort McMurray and Sylvan Lake.

stories.title: Grey Cup matchup against Edmonton brings plenty of history for Alouettes’ GM, coach
stories.summary: The Montreal Alouettes' head coach Jason Maas and general manager Danny Maciocia both have extensive experience with the Edmonton football team: 'Good friends with a lot of them.'

stories.title: Sweden says it won’t play Russia at world juniors as Norway faces losing spot
stories.summary: The Swedish Ice Hockey Association says it sympathized with Norway, which qualified for the world juniors hockey tournament in Alberta but now risks losing its place.

stories.title: Norway says it has been bumped for Russia to compete at world juniors in Canada
stories.summary: The Norwegian Ice Hockey Association said Sunday it has been informed that it is being bumped by Russia from competing in the world junior championships in Canada.

stories.title: Flames winger Farabee finds his breakaway touch
stories.summary: Calgary Flames head coach Ryan Huska said at the beginning of the NHL season he expected a lot from Joel Farabee.
